pins.head: TWO ROLLS COVER MOST JOBS
pins.title: Permanent or Removable Vinyl: Which Roll Each Project Needs
pins.desc: Removable vinyl comes off a painted wall or a rented window without taking the finish with it. Permanent vinyl is the one that survives a dishwasher and a winter outdoors. Most crafters only need one roll of each, not a rainbow of both. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive craft vinyl in coral and cream on a wooden table with scissors, a weeding hook and a cut leaf decal, with the headline Two Rolls Cover Most Jobs.

pins.head: BASKETS BEAT CABINETS
pins.title: Organize a Small Apartment Without Buying Furniture First
pins.desc: A console you already own plus four matching baskets does what a cabinet does, costs a fraction, and moves out with you. Decide what each basket holds before you buy it, or you end up with four boxes of unsorted things at the door. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A small apartment entryway with a wooden console of four woven baskets, a hook holding a jacket and a woven bag, and a round mirror above, opening onto a kitchen, with the headline Baskets Beat Cabinets.

pins.head: THE SMALL DOTS GO FIRST
pins.title: Acne Patches: Why Mixed-Size Boxes Run Out Unevenly
pins.desc: In a mixed-size assortment the small patches empty long before the large ones, so the box is finished while half the sheet is still full. Count the sizes you actually use, then work out the price per usable patch instead of the price per box. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Two sheets of hydrocolloid acne patches in different dot sizes, with a clear ruler laid across them, on a white bathroom counter, with the headline The Small Dots Go First.

pins.head: BINS, THEN THE SHELF
pins.title: Under-Sink Organizing: Do the Bins Before the Shelf
pins.desc: Buy the shelf first and you will find it does not clear the trap. Group what lives down there into two bins first, see how much floor is left around the plumbing, and only then measure for a riser. A liner mat under everything catches the slow leak you have not noticed. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: An open teal under-sink cabinet with plumbing, two cream bins holding spray bottles and sponges on a liner mat, with the headline Bins, Then the Shelf.

pins.head: LOW TEMP FOR THIN PLASTIC
pins.title: A Dual-Temperature Glue Gun Handles Foam and Wood Both
pins.desc: High heat grips wood and fabric but melts right through foam, thin plastic and ribbon. A gun with a low setting saves you from keeping two, and a full-size barrel takes the cheaper 7/16 inch sticks instead of the mini ones. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A full-size hot glue gun on a wooden stand beside a glue bottle and loose glue sticks on a craft table, with the headline Low Temp for Thin Plastic.

pins.head: THE BACK LABEL, NOT THE FRONT
pins.title: Supplement Labels: Five Lines Worth Reading Before You Reorder
pins.desc: The front of the bottle sells the count. The back tells you the serving size, how many servings the bottle really holds, and what else is in each one. Two bottles with the same number on the front can be six weeks apart in how long they last. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Three amber supplement bottles beside a notepad, pencil and a glass of water on a bathroom counter, with the headline The Back Label, Not the Front.

pins.head: TOWELS DRY ON THE DOOR
pins.title: Small Bathroom Storage That Leaves the Tile Alone
pins.desc: Over-the-door hooks give two towels their own air on the one surface a renter is allowed to use. Everything that would have gone on a wall shelf goes on a narrow cart instead, and the cart rolls out when you need the floor back. No anchors, no patching at move-out. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Two coral towels on over-the-door hooks in a small bathroom with a teal rolling cart of toilet paper beside the vanity, with the headline Towels Dry on the Door.

pins.head: MEASURE THE BED CLEARANCE
pins.title: Small Bedroom Storage: Measure Under the Bed Before You Buy
pins.desc: Under-bed bins are sold in two or three heights and the difference between them is about an inch. Measure frame to floor, subtract a finger's width for the lid to clear, and buy to that number. A bin that does not slide is a bin you stop using by week two. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A bed with a teal duvet and storage bins tucked underneath, a wooden nightstand and a jute rug alongside, with the headline Measure the Bed Clearance.

pins.head: THE SCOOP IS NOT A SERVING
pins.title: Protein Powder: Compare Cost per Gram, Not per Tub
pins.desc: Some tubs count a serving as one scoop, others as two, and the scoops themselves are not the same size. Divide the price by the grams of protein in the whole tub and the ranking changes. The tub that looked expensive is often the cheaper one per gram. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: An open tub of protein powder with a scoop in it, its lid on the counter beside a clear shaker bottle, next to a sink, with the headline The Scoop Is Not a Serving.

pins.head: A TRAY STOPS THE MUD
pins.title: Small Entryway Setup: A Tray, a Hook and One Shelf
pins.desc: Wet boots on a bare floor are how a deposit disappears. A raised-lip tray inside the door catches the water, one hook takes the bag you carry daily, and a shallow shelf holds keys at eye level. Three pieces, none of them screwed into anything. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: An entryway with a green tote on a door hook, a floating shelf holding a potted plant and a small tray, and two boots on a low boot tray beside a jute rug, with the headline A Tray Stops the Mud.

pins.head: ONE BOX, A WHOLE PALETTE
pins.title: A 20-Tube Acrylic Set Covers a Starter Palette Properly
pins.desc: Buying acrylics one tube at a time gets expensive and you still end up short a mixing white. An introductory twenty-tube set gives you the primaries, the earths and enough white to mix everything else, in sizes you will finish rather than let dry out. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Acrylic paint tubes laid out beside a round ceramic palette with mixed colour dabs and a brush on a wooden table, with the headline One Box, a Whole Palette.

pins.head: CLEAR THE DESK, KEEP THE LAMP
pins.title: Small Home Office: What Actually Earns Desk Space
pins.desc: A compact desk holds about four things before it stops being a work surface. The lamp earns its place, the paper tray earns its place, and everything else goes vertical in a sorter or off the desk entirely. Decide once, and the reset takes five minutes a week after that. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A compact desk with a task lamp, a paper tray and a file sorter of colored folders beside a teal chair, with the headline Clear the Desk, Keep the Lamp.
